Game Overview

Escape the Bots puts players into a casual experience centered on dodge relentless robots and collect coins in this thrilling, fast-paced action game. Master the art of evasion, beat your high scores, and challenge your friends. Simple to pick up, yet hard to put down, perfect for quick bursts of excitement!

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Escape the Bots is easy to pick up. Dodge relentless robots and collect coins in this thrilling, fast-paced action game.
